episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence shares strategies for leveraging past clients by turning properties into rental investments and using bridge loans to facilitate new home purchases. He discusses the benefits of HELOCs and the impact of AI on the mortgage process, providing actionable insights for real estate agents to help their clients unlock new opportunities.
